title: Savoy Family Bible Record — births of children of Eliza Ann Savoy
text:
FAMILY RECORD.

Eliza H. Savoy was
Born 1st Oct 12
Eliza Ann Savoy was
Borned Oct the 12, 1880
George Washington Savoy was Borned Jan 15, 1881[?]
Sallie Elizabele[?] Savoy was Borned Oct the 10, 1881[?]

William Albert Savoy
was Borned Sept the 4th 1880[?]

Mora Ann Savoy was
Borned Sept the 14, 1884

[Caption below image:]
This is from the Bible of George Washinton Savoy
showing who must be his mother
Eliza Ann Savoy
she married
Louis Savoy
in Mississippi
notes: Handwritten cursive, partially difficult to read. Some dates uncertain — the year digits for several entries are ambiguous between 1880 and 1881. Middle name of Sallie is spelled 'Elizabele' (possibly Elizabelle or Elizabell). Caption is a typed modern annotation below the scanned bible page. 'Mora' may be 'Nora' or 'Dora' — cursive M/N ambiguous.
